rows.notes: Kaji reveals Marduk nonexistent and NERV controls affair; no invented shell companies.

rows.notes: Misato verifies Ikari is behind it; deliberately elliptical follow-up retained. Final supplies natural English question verb without changing referent.

rows.notes: Kaji requests data from combat against Tsentr prototype Medius Locus; data recipient is Kaji.

rows.notes: Kaji identifies Eldy as person associated with Medius; female sourced glossary.

rows.en: ! How do you know about that?
rows.notes: Misato surprised at Kaji knowledge.

rows.notes: Kaji Japanese snake proverb: insiders know insiders methods. Snake image retained because preceding covert knowledge makes meaning accessible; no literal snake claim.
uncertain: The Japanese insider-knowledge proverb is rendered with its snake image; cultural phrasing merits optional review.

rows.en: Then you're saying Eldy Middi was involved with MAGI... No, with NERV?
rows.notes: Misato corrects MAGI to NERV affiliation; later 80 denial read, so this remains her question rather than factual conclusion.

rows.en: That's not what I mean. She was probably brought in as outside staff...
rows.notes: Kaji answers Misato about Erde; she is sourced female. Deliberate cutoff about her outside-staff role retained.

rows.en: ...Oops, I've said too much again. Anyway, I'd like you to copy the data for me.
rows.notes: Kaji asks Misato for the copy; restored request direction and repeated oversharing.

rows.notes: Misato offers a conditional acceptance; implied copying supplied by prior row, conditional fragment retained. Runtime lead nicknames unchanged.

Yes.
As scheduled, huh? You were supposed to do it at the Matsushiro test site, weren't you? In case something went wrong...
rows.notes: Matsushiro established glossary term; precaution preserved.

rows.en: There's no point complaining now about something that's already been decided.
Anyway, could you go pick up the Fourth Child?
Shinji... will bring him here.

rows.notes: Him is Shinji; Ritsuko assumes Misato told Shinji about Toji.

rows.notes: Toji restored from source本人 and previous scene.

rows.en: ...I see.
I'd like to think... telling him made things a little easier for Toji.
rows.notes: Toji is anxious child; telling Shinji is prior action. It is tempting to read Shinji, so referent flagged for review.
uncertain: Referent inference: Toji rather than Shinji; compare preceding exchange.

rows.en: That's a convenient way to look at it.

rows.en: ...Yes, it really is.
...It's almost time. Let's go, Shinji.

Suzuhara...

rows.notes: Class Rep is fixed Hikari nickname; Toji asks Hikari why she stopped him.

rows.en: ...Shinji, Shinji!
Asuka? You were here too?
Come to the convenience store with me for a minute.
rows.notes: Convenience store invitation is Asuka giving Hikari privacy with Toji.

rows.en: Then Toji can come with us...
rows.notes: Trailing suggestion retained rather than inventing completed conditional.

rows.en: Oh, come on! Are you an idiot!? Just come with me!

rows.notes: Shinji waits for Toji, not vice versa.

rows.en: Huh? Oh... Got it.
Um, Suzuhara...
rows.notes: Honorific dropped under established convention; Suzuhara surname preserved.

rows.en: Hm?
I have two sisters, you know. Their names are Kodama and Nozomi. I always make their lunches, but...
rows.notes: Sisters, names and Hikari cooking their lunches all retained; source trailing but remains.

rows.en: Sounds like a lot of work.
So, believe it or not... I'm actually a pretty good cook.
Huh... Really?
So, I... always have ingredients left over from making their lunches.
rows.notes: Ingredients, not finished lunches, retained.

rows.en: That... sounds like a waste.
Huh...?
If you need someone to polish off the leftovers, I'll help as much as you like.
rows.notes: Polish off the leftovers preserves playful food-disposal phrasing and offer direction.

rows.en: Yeah... Please help me.
rows.notes: Hikari asks Toji to help; not an offer from Hikari.

rows.en: Well, I... gotta go.
Where?
...I can't tell you yet. But I'll tell you properly when I get back.
rows.notes: Toji withholds test destination, promises explanation afterward.

We've done nothing but fight... But when I get back, let's try to get along a little better.
rows.notes: We includes Toji/Hikari, preserving mutual history and future request.

rows.en: Y-yeah...!
One minute until the EVA-03 activation test. All cooling systems normal. Main power normal.
rows.notes: Officer-style checklist; every cooling subsystem and main-power check retained.

At this rate, we could send it straight into combat.
rows.notes: It refers to EVA-03; combat readiness, not already deployed.

rows.notes: Context: Misato discusses the squad. Decision: plural they refers to squad personnel; retain four, exclusive possession and world-destruction force.

rows.notes: Context: Ritsuko answers Misato. Decision: retain ominous speculation, not an assertion.
